events.title: Donald Knuth publishes TAOCP Volume 1
events.summary: Donald Knuth published Volume 1 of The Art of Computer Programming in 1968 — foundational algorithms text still cited today.
events.about: TAOCP systematized algorithm analysis for generations of computer scientists. Knuth also created TeX and literate programming — tools that shaped how papers and books are typeset in CS.

narrative.whyChosen: TAOCP remains the benchmark reference for algorithms and rigorous CS writing.
narrative.whyImportant: It established Big-O analysis and structured algorithm exposition as standard practice.
narrative.problemSolved: Computer science lacked a comprehensive, quality-controlled algorithms canon.
